explanation: The arc formula divides each change by the average of the two values, so going from €80 back to €100 gives the same -1.5. The start-point formula divides by whichever value comes first: from €100 to €80 it gives -2.0, and from €80 back to €100 about -1.14. The arc formula does not halve the changes; it divides them by the midpoints.
